messages:
ali: hey hello, i'm Ali, first day on infra-setup for a private model. quick: who owns VPC/subnet allocation vs who issues service principals/roles? also, what's the canonical pager path during a rollout (eng-sre vs infra), and who approves Dedicated allocation/billing dashboard access?

onboarding-bot: welcome @ali — start at https://redwood.internal/onboard. Use the infra-access Jira template for infra requests.

sophia: eng-infra takes VPC/subnet allocations, peering, route tables. open an infra-access ticket with the vpc template and include project, env, desired CIDR and estimated instances. Example: `Project=llm-feature; Env=private; CIDR=10.244.0.0/22; Owner=ali`.

infra-dns: DNS & certs: handled by infra-dns. Add hostname + internal/external flag to your ticket. We wait until subnets are active before issuing certs.

eng-sre: paging rules: page `eng-sre-oncall` for service outages, SLO breaches, or unexplained errors. Page `infra-ops` for network flaps, capacity failures, and provisioning errors. For planned rollouts, page eng-sre in advance and include runbook + dashboards; we'll escalate to infra if needed. Phone only for P0s. Use `/pager eng-sre-oncall <one-line>` to page.

infra-leads: Dedicated capacity requires infra-lead + finance signoff. For read-only billing dashboards request `billing-read` in the identity portal and include cost-center and approver. For Dedicated admin/provisioning tag `infra-leads` on the ticket and include expected vGPU-hours.

ali: awesome thank you — last Q: who should I cc on the infra ticket for a canary to avoid surprises?

sophia: cc `eng-sre`, `product-ops`, and `security` if data is sensitive. Add a short rollback plan and metric thresholds.

ali: perfect, i'll open the infra-access ticket now with CIDR, hostnames, billing cost-center and cc the teams. thanks! :thumbsup:
